vibe.title: Vibe Check
vibe.content:
🎙 TODAY 7:45: TURKEY TROT INTERVIEW WITH BRIAN HAGERTY & KAT PAYE
Courtney booked Brian Hagerty (Turkey Trot organizer) and Kat Paye (National Cherry Festival Executive Director) in studio at 7:45 AM to talk Thursday's 19th annual Traverse City Turkey Trot. Watch for them arriving around 7:45 — nobody else may be at the station yet.

SLOW JAM: K-CI & JOJO, "ALL MY LIFE" (1998)
• STAT: It topped the Billboard Hot 100 for three straight weeks in 1998, the duo's longest-running No. 1.
• STORY: JoJo Hailey wrote it, and the lyric came from words his daughter said in the studio. He first meant it for a female artist, then decided to keep it.
• WHY TODAY: Day before Thanksgiving, the 'thankful for you' slow jam. Play it for the person who's driving you to Grandma's.
➜ TAKE: Every 1998 middle school dance ended with this song and a chaperone walking around with a yardstick.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: who's the person you're most thankful for this year? We'll read a few.
😂 JOKES: 'All My Life' was No. 1 for three weeks. My slow-dance career lasted three seconds. / JoJo wrote it from something his daughter said. My kid's lyrics would be 'Can I have your phone?'

🚗 DRIVE TEASE: Cold and calm for the drive in. About 27 at 6 AM and 28 by 8, no wind to speak of, and dry roads. Up to a high near 41 this afternoon.

📅 THIS DAY: THE BAND'S 'LAST WALTZ' ON THANKSGIVING, 1976
• On Thanksgiving Day, Nov. 25, 1976, The Band played its farewell concert, The Last Waltz, at Winterland Ballroom in San Francisco.
• Guests included Bob Dylan, Joni Mitchell, Neil Young, Van Morrison, Eric Clapton, Neil Diamond and Ringo Starr.
• The 5,000 fans were served turkey dinners starting at 5 PM, and Martin Scorsese filmed it, a movie Rolling Stone later called the greatest concert movie of all time.
➜ TAKE: A rock concert that served 5,000 turkey dinners. That's the only show where the mosh pit had gravy.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: best concert you ever saw over a holiday weekend?
😂 JOKES: Bob Dylan, Neil Young and Joni Mitchell, plus turkey. My family Thanksgiving has my uncle, a guitar with five strings, and Stove Top. / Scorsese filmed the whole thing. At my house, the only thing that gets filmed is Grandpa falling asleep during the Lions.

💡 FUN FACT: GTA 6 PLAYERS LOGGED ABOUT 78,000 YEARS IN FOUR DAYS
• Sony says PlayStation players logged 683 million hours of GTA 6 from Nov. 19 to 22.
• Do the math, and 683 million hours is roughly 78,000 years of play time.
• That's an average of 17.4 hours per player, in four days.
➜ TAKE: Seventy-eight thousand years in one weekend. Somewhere a Leonida traffic cop is still writing tickets.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: what's the longest you ever played one game in a single weekend?
😂 JOKES: Seventy-eight thousand years is also how long it feels waiting for the turkey to rest. / Seventeen hours per player. My nephew did that by Friday lunch.

🎉 NATIONAL DAYS: National Parfait Day · Shopping Reminder Day · National Play Day With Dad · Blasé Day

GOOD MORNING UP NORTH: Cold and calm to start, about 27 at 6 AM, then mostly cloudy with a high near 41 and barely a breeze. Tonight's low is about 29. Thanksgiving Day looks mostly cloudy with a high near 45 and a light northeast breeze.

SCHOOLS: No closings or delays listed this morning.

ROADS: Dry and cold. South Airport Road has lane closures at Logan's Landing, so leave extra time if you're headed that way.

ENERGY: Thanksgiving eve. Biggest travel day, last grocery run, and the Christmas Ship's already loaded. No show tomorrow, so we're doing it all today.

mood.content:
MOOD BOOST: DEEP BLUE SOMETHING, "BREAKFAST AT TIFFANY'S" (1995)
• STAT: It peaked at No. 5 on the Billboard Hot 100 in January 1996 and went all the way to No. 1 on the UK Singles Chart.
• STORY: Released as a single in July 1995, it was the Texas band's only big U.S. hit, so yes, the textbook one-hit wonder.
• FUN PART: Bassist Todd Pipes told Q magazine that because the song had 'breakfast' in the title, radio stations kept booking them for breakfast-time shows.
➜ TAKE: A song with 'breakfast' in the title, at 6 AM, on a morning show. Deep Blue Something would hate this, and I love it.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: the one '90s song you know every word to, but couldn't name the band.
😂 JOKES: The only thing we've got in common is we both liked that song. That's also how my whole friend group started. / Breakfast at Tiffany's? Around here it's breakfast at the Omelette Shoppe, and the vibe is the same.

━━ LOCAL ━━

⭐ THE CHRISTMAS SHIP SAILS AGAIN: 1,400 TREES ON THE CUTTER MACKINAW
• SUMMARY: Hundreds of hands loaded 1,400 northern Michigan Christmas trees onto the U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Mackinaw in Cheboygan on Tuesday. The trees head to families in Chicago, and the Cheboygan Area Chamber collects nearly 3,000 decorated letters to send along with them.
• THE CATCH: On the way, the crew holds a wreath ceremony where the original Christmas tree ship, the Rouse Simmons, went down in a 1912 storm. Every year the Coast Guard invites schools and the community to help load.
• WHO: The Cutter Mackinaw crew, local schools and the Cheboygan Area Chamber. WHAT: 1,400 trees loaded. WHERE: Cheboygan. WHEN: Loaded Tuesday, with a public send-off UpNorthLive lists for 'next Saturday' at 10 a.m. at the Cheboygan County Marina. WHY IT MATTERS: A northern Michigan tree is going to be somebody's living-room Christmas in Chicago.
➜ TAKE: Northern Michigan doesn't just grow Christmas trees. We ship them by icebreaker. Try topping that, Amazon.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: real tree or fake tree at your house? And when does it go up?
😂 JOKES: A Coast Guard icebreaker full of Christmas trees. That's the most Michigan sentence ever spoken. / Fourteen hundred trees on one ship. I can't even get one tree on top of my car without a neighbor holding the twine.

SIGN THE LAST STEEL BEAM AT CHERRY CAPITAL AIRPORT
• SUMMARY: Cherry Capital Airport is inviting the public to sign the final structural steel beam for its new concourse, part of the 'Gates to the Future' project. The beam is inside the terminal now, and you can sign it through January.
• THE CATCH: It's the last piece of structural steel going into the terminal, so your Sharpie autograph gets built into the airport for good. To sign, you just let a TVC police officer know.
• WHO: Cherry Capital Airport, CEO Kevin Klein. WHAT: Public beam signing. WHERE: Inside the TVC terminal. WHEN: Now through January. WHY IT MATTERS: Klein says he'll bring his own kids and family to sign it, and calls it the first of many ways the public can be part of the project.
➜ TAKE: Busiest travel week of the year, and TVC says, 'While you're here, autograph the building.' Flying home Sunday? Bring a marker.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: if you signed the beam, what would you write? Keep it radio-friendly.
😂 JOKES: Finally, a way to leave your mark at the airport that doesn't involve losing a carry-on. / Sign the beam, and in 50 years your grandkids can point at the ceiling and say, 'That's where Grandpa misspelled Traverse.'

SOUTH AIRPORT ROAD: LANE CLOSURES START TODAY AT LOGAN'S LANDING
• SUMMARY: Single-lane closures in both directions start today, Wednesday, on South Airport Road at Logan's Landing for the Garfield Township sewer replacement. It's daylight hours only, with flaggers and short stops westbound, and the median crossovers are closed.
• THE CATCH: Crews pull the non-essential traffic control for the holiday weekend, and the closures pick back up Monday, Nov. 30. So it's one rough day, then a break.
• WHO: Grand Traverse County Road Commission, for Garfield Township. WHAT: Sewer replacement lane closures. WHERE: South Airport Road at Logan's Landing. WHEN: Daylight hours today, then again from Mon Nov 30. WHY IT MATTERS: That's the road to Meijer, Costco and the airport on the busiest grocery-run day of the year.
➜ TAKE: Of course the lane closure starts on the day every one of us is making a last-minute run for cream of mushroom soup.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487 your best back-way around South Airport. We'll keep it between us and everybody listening.
😂 JOKES: The flaggers today deserve a turkey dinner. Possibly two. / Median crossovers closed. So if you miss your turn, congratulations, you're going to Kalkaska.

TC FIREFIGHTERS SHOW YOU WHAT NOT TO DO WITH A TURKEY FRYER
• SUMMARY: Traverse City firefighters set up a live what-not-to-do demo at Fire Station 1: oil way too hot, a pot filled too full, and a frozen turkey dropped in. The National Fire Protection Association says Thanksgiving Day is the peak day of the year for home cooking fires.
• THE CATCH: In the demo, a firefighter puts water on the grease fire on purpose, to show you why you never, ever do that.

gta6.title: GTA 6 Watch
gta6.content:
GTA 6 WATCH: BIGGEST LAUNCH IN PLAYSTATION HISTORY, PLUS REAL TRADING CARDS
• PLAYSTATION RECORD: Sony's PlayStation Blog says GTA 6 is the biggest launch in PlayStation history. More than 39 million unique players on PS5 from Nov. 19 to 22, 683 million hours played, and an average of 17.4 hours per player.
• NEW CONSOLES: GTA 6 was the first game played on 70 percent of brand-new PS5s, and launch weekend set a PlayStation record for concurrent players.
• TRADING CARDS: Panini and Rockstar announced real GTA 6 trading cards based on the in-game card collectibles, out in December 2026.
• PC (UNOFFICIAL): PC Gamer reports the leads of 'Leonida,' an unofficial effort to get a leaked build running on PC, quit after Rockstar had its Discord server taken down. There's still no official PC version or date.
➜ TAKE: Seventeen hours per player in four days. That's not a video game, that's a part-time job with car chases.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: how many hours are you in? Be honest, your family's going to ask tomorrow.
😂 JOKES: Thirty-nine million people played GTA over one weekend. That explains why nobody returned my calls. / GTA trading cards. Finally, something from the game Grandma can hold and still not understand.

lifestyle.content:
MICHIGAN GAS PRICES JUMPED RIGHT BEFORE THE HOLIDAY DRIVE
• SUMMARY: AAA says 73 million Americans are traveling this week, and 90 percent of them are driving. Michigan gas prices had been trending down, then made an overnight U-turn.
• THE CATCH: GasBuddy's Patrick De Haan, who's tracked prices for about 20 years, said his blood was boiling, because Michigan went up while virtually every other state was falling.
• WHO: GasBuddy's Patrick De Haan. WHAT: An unexplained price spike. WHERE: Stations across Michigan. WHY IT MATTERS: He says the margin is the part that varies, and he couldn't find a rational reason for the jump.
➜ TAKE: ➜ LOCAL ANGLE: Fill up before you head to Grandma's, and if you see a cheaper station on US-31, tell the rest of us.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487 the cheapest gas you've seen this morning, and where.
😂 JOKES: When the GasBuddy guy's blood is boiling, you know it's bad. That man is usually calmer than a Sunday at Meijer. / Michigan gas went up while the whole country went down. We're contrarians, even at the pump.

THE GREAT PIE POLL: 1 IN 5 DOESN'T EVEN EAT PIE
• SUMMARY: A new Siena poll of New Yorkers found 73 percent have a favorite Thanksgiving pie, but one in five don't eat pie at Thanksgiving at all.
• THE CATCH: 31 percent plan to go to a Friendsgiving this year, and about 2 in 5 people under 50 do.
• WHO: Siena Research Institute. WHAT: Thanksgiving habits poll of 870 New York State residents. WHEN: Taken Nov. 9 to 18, released Nov. 24. WHY IT MATTERS: It's one state, but the pie debate is universal.
➜ TAKE: ➜ LOCAL ANGLE: Up here the pie answer is cherry, and I will not be taking questions.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: your Thanksgiving pie. Pumpkin, apple, pecan, cherry, or are you a no-pie person?
😂 JOKES: One in five people don't eat pie at Thanksgiving. I'd like to meet them, from a safe distance. / Friendsgiving is just Thanksgiving where nobody asks about your love life.

officeschool.title: Office & School Bits
officeschool.content:
OFFICE: THE WEDNESDAY BEFORE THANKSGIVING IS A GHOST TOWN
• LISTENER BIT: The office on the day before Thanksgiving is half empty, and the half that's there is mostly planning the drive.
• Who's in, who's out, and who 'has a dentist appointment' at 1 o'clock?
➜ TAKE: Every office has the one person who answers emails at 4:59 today just to prove they were there.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: are you working a full day today, a half day, or is your out-of-office already on?
😂 JOKES: My out-of-office says 'returning Monday.' It doesn't say which Monday. / Today the break room fridge is just one yogurt and a sticky note that says 'please.'

OFFICE: WORKERS ARE USING THE COMPANY DISCOUNT ON BLACK FRIDAY
• A survey from the employee benefits platform Boostworks found 64 percent of workers with workplace discounts plan to use them on Black Friday purchases.
• 87 percent say price, discounts and offers decide where they shop, versus 26 percent who say brand loyalty does.
• 71 percent are buying Christmas gifts, and 67 percent are buying stuff for the house for themselves.
➜ TAKE: The best job perk isn't the free coffee. It's the 15 percent off you forgot you had.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: what's the best employee perk you've ever had?
😂 JOKES: Brand loyalty is dead. My loyalty goes to whoever has the shortest checkout line. / Sixty-seven percent are buying gifts for themselves. Same. Merry Christmas to me, from me.

SCHOOL: 'SKIP SCHOOL WEDNESDAY' IS A REAL THING
• The Boston Globe reports the day before Thanksgiving is one of the most frustrating days of the year for school leaders.
• Last year, more than 12,000 Boston public school students, about one in four, were marked absent that Wednesday.
• One district made the day a holiday, and kids just skipped Tuesday instead.
➜ TAKE: Kids will find a way. Give them Wednesday, they take Tuesday. Give them Tuesday, they take Monday. By 2030 Thanksgiving break starts on Halloween.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: did your parents ever let you skip the day before Thanksgiving?
😂 JOKES: One district made Wednesday a holiday, and the kids skipped Tuesday. That's not truancy, that's negotiation. / If your kid is home today, they're not skipping school. They're on turkey duty.

SCHOOL: HOW DID YOUR KID SAY TO COOK THE TURKEY?
• LISTENER BIT: It's the classic preschool and kindergarten assignment: 'How do you cook a turkey?'
• Kids' answers usually involve 400 minutes, 5 degrees and a whole bottle of ketchup.
• Read us your kid's recipe, word for word.
➜ TAKE: Honestly, the kid recipes are about as accurate as mine.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487 your kid's turkey recipe. We'll read the best ones.

mental.title: Mental Health Minute
mental.content:
TAKE A TEN-MINUTE WALK BEFORE THE CHAOS

Today's the day the house fills up, the grocery list gets longer, and somebody calls asking if they should bring rolls. Before all of that hits, here's one small move. Step outside for ten minutes and just walk. It's calm out there this morning, no wind, and it climbs to about 41 this afternoon, so grab a coat and go around the block. Researchers have found that even a short walk, ten or fifteen minutes, tends to shift your mood in a better, calmer direction. You don't need a plan or a step goal. Leave the phone in your pocket, notice the cold air and the quiet, and let your shoulders drop a little. Then come back in and start the day a little lighter than you left it. If you take that walk today, text me at 231-929-4487 and tell me what you noticed out there.
mental.notes:
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10863677/
Ekkekakis et al. 2000, J Behav Med (10-15 min walks shift affect positively). Supported by later meta-analysis (JMIR 2024, PMC11287235). No clinical claims; weather matches NWS (calm, high near 41).

• Released as a single: August 1988 (lead single from Sunshine on Leith); U.S. release 1993 after Benny & Joon

SHOW OPENER SUPERCUT: NATIONAL PARFAIT DAY (EVERYBODY LIKES LAYERS) · SHOW OPENER SUPERCUT
🔈 AUDIO SOURCE: Shrek (2001) and Shrek 2 (2004), DreamWorks Animation, clips from YouTube uploads. DRY, no music bed. Mastered about -14 LUFS.
• Shrek 2, Donkey on the road trip: "This is taking forever." / "That's where we're going. Far, far away."
• Shrek: "Onions have layers. Ogres have layers... We both have layers."
• Donkey: "You know, not everybody likes onions." / "Cake! Everybody loves cakes. Cakes have layers."
• Donkey: "You know what else everybody likes? Parfait!"
• Shrek 2 payoff: "Yes! Oh, finally!" (the launch line, straight into your open)
🔊 IN: "This is taking forever." (0:00)
OUT: "Yes! Oh, finally!" (0:23)
~0:23 · PLAY · READY

⚠️ FLAG: Clean. The parfait bite stops before Shrek's 'Hell no' and Donkey's 'damn' later in that scene, NOT in the cut. The 'Are we there yet?' line was left out on purpose (the Thanksgiving extras opener tg00 uses it). The two Shrek 2 bites may have a little score under them; hear it once.

TIM ALLEN DIDN'T KNOW TOY STORY WAS A MOVIE THING · SUPER-CLIP 6 AM

• Allen thought it was a TV event, then saw Matt Damon, Tom Cruise and Zendaya. He was seated with the Pixar people "because of Toy Story. It's a movie." "I have no clue what I'm doing. I don't know where I am."
🔊 IN: "Have these things kick off the big Academy Awards season?" (0:00)
OUT: "...I don't know where I am." (0:58)
~0:59 · PLAY · READY
➜ WHY: Brand-new from last night, a huge star, and a self-deprecating story everybody gets.
⚠️ FLAG: Clean. The transcript garbles one name (he says he's a big fan of Glenn Close); hear it once before you name anyone besides Damon, Cruise and Zendaya. NBC network audio: credit it.

PAST BIT: MARTIN SHORT ON CANADIAN THANKSGIVING · FIRST HALF HOUR: LATE-NIGHT
🎙️ SET UP: Canadians had their Thanksgiving back in October. Martin Short once explained to Jimmy Fallon how they do it up there. "Martin Short, on The Tonight Show."
🔈 AUDIO SOURCE: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon (NBC), official YouTube, Nov. 2017: "Martin Short Explains How Canadians Celebrate Thanksgiving." On-air credit: "from The Tonight Show."
• Canadians say what they're thankful for, then apologize if it sounds like bragging. Whole potatoes, "because mashing requires too much aggression."

OUT: "...it's not a beautiful thing to do." (0:42)

clips.body:
MONOLOGUE JOKES: JUNK FOOD, UBER RIDES, EREWHON, AND CANDIED YAMS · FIRST HALF HOUR: LATE-NIGHT
🎙️ SET UP: A few of the clean jokes from last night's opening monologues — Jimmy Fallon, then Seth Meyers. "From The Tonight Show and Late Night."
🔈 AUDIO SOURCE: Official YouTube, both posted Nov. 25 from the Tuesday night shows. Fallon: The Tonight Show, "Trump Hosts Annual White House Turkey Pardon," https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZL81l3xirDY (Uber and junk-food jokes only). Meyers: Late Night, "Trump Says Musk Is '80% Super Genius,' Refuses to Name the Rest," https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aBDHdxkWq3k (Erewhon and cooking-guide jokes only). Four bites, short crossfades, no bed. On-air credit: "from The Tonight Show and Late Night."
– Fallon: Uber is testing a program so parents can order rides for kids 10 to 12. We grew up hearing never get in a car with a stranger; now it's, put your jackets on, Igor is here to take you to grandpa's. Kids can rate the drivers Gucci, fire, mid, unc, or trud.
– Fallon: A new study found that quitting junk food could bring back lost memories. He doesn't remember where he read that study, but the new Smokin' Barbecue Takis are Gucci.
– Meyers: LA luxury grocery Erewhon is offering a dinner package for $750. It includes turkey, stuffing, pumpkin pie, and three gallons of gas.
– Meyers: Business Insider published a guide for when to start cooking each dish, like the turkey around noon, and the candied yams around never.
🔊 IN: "I have read that Uber is testing a program..." (0:00)
OUT: "...and the candied yams around never." (1:03)
~1:03 · PLAY · READY
➜ WHY: This is the late-night look Truce asked for — the best clean jokes from different hosts' opening monologues, about a minute.
⚠️ FLAG: Clean. Last night's official monologues (Tue Nov 24 shows, posted Wed morning). The cuts skip Fallon's turkey-pardon and FAA bits (those have politics and curses) and skip Meyers' political open, a Florida drugs/underwear joke, and a morning-after-pill joke, none of which are in the file. The Uber joke mentions a parental ride program for ages 10-12; it's a parenting joke, not a kids' bit. Colbert has no current monologue. Kimmel's Mon and Tue monologues didn't have a clean standalone joke we could air.

lifestyle.summary: SUMMARY: AAA says 73 million Americans are traveling this week, and 90 percent of them are driving. Michigan gas prices had been trending down, then made an overnight U-turn.
